settings.spot_density: closed 1-hop graph neighbourhood mean of (ECM + CAF)/2
settings.spot_distance: signed Euclidean distance to the tumour compartment boundary (um)
settings.spot_niche: binomial z of stromal-neighbour count (p = section stromal fraction)
settings.section_density: mean (ECM + CAF)/2 over non-tumour spots adjacent to tumour
settings.section_distance: median distance from vessel spots to the nearest tumour spot (um)
settings.section_niche: tumour-stroma contact z vs 1,000 label permutations (Squidpy-style)
settings.b_rel: max flow with uniform capacity sigma(a) / max flow with matrix capacities
